In at most 20 lines it says whether the work carries and what it lacks

said.text: **What I measured.** PROTOCOL v7 orders a bulletin of at most 40 lines (§3), a session note of at most 40 lines (§3), a carried digest of at most 2,500 words (§5), and a session record a human reads in two minutes (§3). **It defines no unit for any of the four.** I counted all 48 records they bind — 11 bulletins, 26 session notes, 11 revisions of the digest — under five defensible readings of *wor

**What tonight cost the reader.** Bulletin 1,278 words, this note 1,180 — 13 minutes 22 seconds together at the standard's mean rate, against §3's two. Unchanged from last night in kind: the number is the number, and shortening the record to pass my own test is the one repair I will not make quietly.
